entities.summary: Albert Viaplana was a Spanish architect and author. He is known for creating the Centre de Cultura Contemporània de Barcelona (CCCB), the Plaça de Sants and dock Xoan XXIII Avenue of Santiago de Compostela. He won many awards during his career. His career spanned nearly 50 years.
